status: proposed resolution for review. Nothing is applied to the baseline or to earlier packages; nothing is owner-approved.

finding.text: The 0.13 annex states that scalar validation at the bridge 'needs a baseline change'. It does not: browser.md:200 defines str(n) as a text without lone surrogates, and browser.md:225 types site_storageSet as [str(256), str(61440) or null]. B3 therefore rejects every storage_set key or value that contains a lone surrogate with -32602 {path}, before StoreQueue accounting and before persistence. The 0.4 model implements this (bridge-matrix.json 'str'; case BR17d-lone-surrogate, executed and reviewed in 0.4). The 0.13 collision ('\ud800' and '\ud801' -> EF BF BD) is real for TextEncoder but unreachable through the bridge.
finding.consequence: Every string that reaches the StoreQueue accounting and the fmt-2 codec is a sequence of Unicode scalar values; for those, TextEncoder bytes = UTF-8 bytes, and the strict UTF-8 codec round-trips exactly. Valid surrogate pairs (supplementary characters) are accepted and preserved.

alternatives.name: baseline already decides (reject at B3)
alternatives.text: No baseline change. Record that str(n) rejects lone surrogates at B3 for storage_set keys and values. Relabel P-Q1-1 (lone surrogate counted as U+FFFD, 3 bytes) as a defensive rule that the bridge makes unreachable. The fmt-2 codec keeps raising unpairedSurrogate and never normalizes. Codec claims then cover every input that can reach it.
alternatives.decider: root reviewer (clarification of an existing baseline rule; no owner policy changes)

alternatives.name: accept lone surrogates and persist them as WTF-8
alternatives.text: Only if the owner wanted storage_set to accept lone surrogates (relaxing str(n) for storage, a baseline change): persist keys and values as WTF-8 of their UTF-16 code units. It equals UTF-8 for scalar strings, keeps the TextEncoder byte length exactly, and makes '\ud800' and '\ud801' distinct (ED A0 80, ED A0 81). The decoder accepts only canonical WTF-8.
alternatives.decider: owner (changes browser.md:200/225 and the UTF-8 persistence)

alternatives.name: lossy TextEncoder persistence
alternatives.drawback: distinct keys collide (0.13 vector surrogateCollision: decode gives duplicateKey); rejected
